hazards.description: Endpoint misaddressing — a request resolves to the wrong (stream_id, byte_bus_id)-addressed endpoint
Safety-tagged request lost — a Critical-priority/safety-tagged request is silently dropped instead of executed or explicitly failed
Replayed request — a previously valid request is re-injected and executed out of its intended context
Payload corruption — a bitflip in a safe-point request/response payload causes erroneous actuation
Endpoint/stream lockup undetected — the per-stream watchdog fails to flag an unresponsive endpoint
Unauthorized request execution — a caller dispatches an (endpoint-type, request-type) pair outside its granted allowlist
Power-state transition race — requests processed during a Normal/StandBy/Sleep/Unpowered transition or cold/hot start handshake cause undefined behaviour
Frame/payload length overflow — a malformed NTSCF/ACF length field enables an oversized allocation or malformed decode
Request flooding denial of service — a flood of Standard-priority requests starves Critical-priority/safety-tagged request dispatch
Register-map integrity bypass — a write reaches a register the RC Server's lifecycle state or root-client policy should have blocked

operational_situations.description: ECU firmware update in service mode

safety_goals.description: Requests shall only be delivered to the correct addressed endpoint
Safety-tagged requests shall not be silently dropped
Replayed frames shall be detected and rejected
Payload integrity shall be verified before execution
Unresponsive endpoints shall be detected within the watchdog window
Only authorized callers may dispatch a given (endpoint-type, request-type) pair
Power state transitions shall be atomic with respect to concurrent requests
Frame/payload length fields shall be validated before memory allocation
Critical-priority/safety-tagged requests shall not be delayed by lower-priority flooding
Register writes shall be rejected unless permitted by both the current lifecycle state and root-client policy
